The study's objective was to engineer a solution that maximizes the decarbonization of available BF gas by capturing up to 2.8 mtpa of CO at an optimal carbon capture cost, 2 thus enabling the production of low carbon emissions steel through the BF route at a competitive cost structure. The key envisaged elements of the study scope were: a) A preliminary and detailed design of the CO capture (CC) island. 2 b) A preliminary and detailed design of the Balance of Plant (BOP) and integration with the CC island. c) Studies and investigations include a steam and electricity sourcing study, a solvent disposal investigation, a wastewater treatment study, a permitting study and review, a hazard and operability review (HAZOP), and a constructability review. d) Detailed costing of the project includes assessing the capital cost of major equipment and the BOP, including construction costs, project indirect costs, and operating and maintenance costs. e) Report submissions include an initial engineering design and cost estimate, a techno-economic analysis (TEA), and an environmental health and safety (EH&S) risk assessment. 3.1 Project Tasks The following tasks have been completed in carrying out this study: Task 1.0 Project Management and Planning Subtask 1.1 Project Management Plan Dastur International Inc. managed and directed the project per the Project Management Plan to meet all technical, schedule, and budget objectives and requirements by coordinating the activities to accomplish the work effectively. Management of project risks occurred by the risk management methodology has been delineated in the Project Management Plan to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate technical uncertainties and schedule, budgetary and environmental risks associated with all aspects of the project. Subtask 1.2 Technology Maturation Plan Dastur has developed a Technology Maturation Plan (TMP) that describes the proposed technology's current readiness level (TRL) along with the development needed for further maturation of the technology. Attachment 10 talks about the Technology Maturation Plan. Subtask 1.3 Data Management Plan Dastur has developed a Data management Plan (DMP) that describes the type of data generated during the project. The DMP managed the data sharing and preservation procedure to enable the validation of the results from the proposed study. The protocols followed for the control, flow, and archival of data, information, and documents amongst the project stakeholders have been described.
